_meta.indication: Indicated in patients treated with Pradaxa when reversal of the anticoagulant effects of dabigatran is needed: for emergency surgery/urgent procedures, and in life-threatening or uncontrolled bleeding

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, multicenter single cohort case series safety and efficacy trial with projected enrollment of up to 300 adult patients
pivotal_trials.population: Dabigatran-treated patients with life-threatening or uncontrolled bleeding (Group A) or requiring emergency surgery/urgent procedures (Group B); median age 77 years, 40% with moderate or severe renal insufficiency
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Maximum percentage reversal of the pharmacodynamic anticoagulant effect of dabigatran within 4 hours after idarucizumab, based on central laboratory dTT or ECT
pivotal_trials.n: Interim analysis included 123 patients (66 with serious bleeding, 57 requiring urgent procedure)
pivotal_trials.result: Median maximum reversal of the anticoagulant effect (ECT or dTT) within 4 hours was 100%, with most patients (>89%) achieving complete reversal; maximal dTT reversal in 98% of bleeding and 93% of surgery patients, maximal ECT reversal in 89% of bleeding and 88% of surgery patients

key_safety: In patients, most frequent adverse reactions (>=5%) were hypokalemia, delirium, constipation, pyrexia, and pneumonia; in healthy volunteers the most frequent (>=5%) was headache. Thromboembolic events occurred in 5 of 123 patients in RE-VERSE AD; hypersensitivity reactions (pyrexia, bronchospasm, hyperventilation, rash, and pruritus) also reported.
target_moa: A specific reversal agent for dabigatran; a humanized monoclonal antibody fragment (Fab) that binds dabigatran and its acylglucuronide metabolites with higher affinity than dabigatran's binding to thrombin, neutralizing their anticoagulant effect
modality: mAb (humanized monoclonal antibody fragment, Fab, derived from an IgG1 isotype)

advisory_committee.vote: Not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues unexpected for a drug/biologic of this class

description.text: Converted accelerated approval to full approval by fulfilling PMR 2977-1 with the final REVERSE-AD trial report

citations.quote: We approved this BLA under the regulations at 21 CFR 601 Subpart E for Accelerated Approval of Biological Products for Serious or Life-Threatening Illnesses. Approval of this supplement fulfills your commitment made under 21 CFR 601.41.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Reduction in unbound dabigatran and normalization of coagulation parameters in healthy volunteers (reversal of elevated coagulation tests considered a surrogate for clinical efficacy)

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on a reduction in unbound dabigatran and normalization of coagulation parameters in healthy volunteers [see Clinical Studies (14)]. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon the results of an ongoing cohort case series study.
Reversal of elevated coagulation tests is considered a surrogate for clinical efficacy.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Required postmarketing clinical trial to verify and describe clinical benefit — PMR 2977-1 Trial 1321.3, the REVERSE-AD trial (trial completion 10/2017, final report 10/2018)

citations.quote: Products approved under the accelerated approval regulations, 21 CFR 601.41, require further adequate and well-controlled clinical trials to verify and describe clinical benefit.
